Out of focus: Setup › Apps is outside #34571's scope. The effect is real: the admin is left with no default app until they set one again. Alone that would be p2, so one grade lower out of focus gives p3. Kept open, not closed.

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in area:build · domain:ui · Bug · p1 · pm:queue · size S; rationale: in Setup › Apps, "Set as default" on an app in a read-only package first clears the current default, then its own write is refused, and nothing rolls back. The deployment is left with no default app (reproduced twice). The refusal is shown, but the lost default is not: a silent lost update, so p3 → p1. Graded, not chased (area:build has no seat). Audit restatement, tier 3. Recorded 2026-11-27T13:21Z.

- Fix direction (the card's Expected, either branch): a refused promote leaves `/meta/app` unchanged — restore each demoted app when the promote fails (keeps the comment's "never two" property), and/or refuse a target known to be read-only before any write. A failed restore is reported, not hidden.
- Owes: L1 (L1-a); no L2 (no contract face).
